task: There is a 10x-genomics single cell CellRanger data with RNA-seq and TCR-seq (contig annotations) data. Load the data, perform preprocessing and quality control. You can filter cells and genes with thresholds you see fit or not at all. Filter out orphan chains and samples without TCR data. Find the remaining number of cells that have exactly one productive alpha and one productive beta chain. Find the total number of remaining cells. Define clonotypes. For cells with multiple chains, use only the primary receptor chains. Find the total number of identified clonotypes. Find the number of cells in the largest clonotype.
